newsitem.title: CHINA: China says domestic debt issue far from burdensome.
newsitem.headline: China says domestic debt issue far from burdensome.

text.p: China's domestic debt is far from being a burden om the economy and financial authorities will raise the annual issue of debt within reasonable limits, the Business Weekly said on Sunday.

China's domestic debt issue accounted for just around three percent of its gross domestic product, well below the levels of most other countries, the newspaper quoted an official of the Ministry of Finance as saying.
"The ministry (of finance) will not hesitate to escalate the annual issue of T-bonds with reasonable limits," the official said but gave no details.
China had issued 195.2 billion yuan ($23.5 billion) in treasury bills and bonds this year, up from 151 billion yuan in 1995, the newspaper said.
China began issuing this year's last batch of debt worth 20 billion yuan on November 1 and is scheduled to conclude the issue on November 20.
